summary: Refined enterprise cloud architecture elevation plan for Zaboraa Technologies. Synthesizes verified observable patterns from all 4 reference websites (Atlas Orthopaedie, The Clean Fox, The Döner, and Nike Slider), strictly maps every design element to enterprise business objectives, removes unverified claims, enforces honest labeling for architecture benchmarks, prioritizes scope into Essential/Next/Optional tiers, and provides a component-level implementation roadmap with risks and testing protocols.
